t.zh: 酒吧里至少有一个人。「∃x. x在喝酒 → ∀y. y在喝酒」说的是：有这么一个人，只要他喝酒，大家就都在喝。
t.en: There is at least one person in the pub. “∃x. x is drinking → ∀y. y is drinking” says: there is someone such that, if they drink, everyone drinks.

after.zh: 听着荒唐，却是经典逻辑的定理：证明说有这么一个人，却不指出是谁。
after.en: It sounds absurd, yet it is a theorem of classical logic: the proof says such a person exists without saying who.

hint.zh: 别急着找那个人。先问：是不是大家都在喝？
hint.en: Do not look for that person yet. Ask first: is everyone drinking?

hint.en: If not everyone is drinking, what does <part-ref to="lemma:dm"></part-ref> give?
